name: llmscope
description: Deterministic LLM bias eval harness: swap identity variables in a prompt, run across models via OpenRouter (bring your own key), measure refusals, keywords, length and sentiment, and render a shareable card.

scripts.demo: node bin/llmscope.js run examples/identity-swap.json --provider mock --svg out/demo.svg --png out/demo.png --out out/demo.results.json
